brief: Disclosures for Sorrento Therapeutics, Inc. trial NCT04903327 (COVI-MSC, phase 2, terminated; primary completion 2022-08-29, completion 2022-11-23). Find what Sorrento told investors in 8-Ks about this trial or COVI-MSC near when it stopped. Quote the 8-K language exactly and say whether it gives a reason.

findings.claim: Sorrento Therapeutics, Inc. filed multiple 8-K filings referencing COVI-MSC as a trademarked product under development in pipeline and press release exhibits near the time trial NCT04903327 completed and stopped, but none of the 8-Ks mention the specific trial NCT04903327 or provide a reason for stopping the trial.
findings.notes: Filings mention COVI-MSC only in trademark and pipeline summary lists without discussing the trial status or reasons for termination.
